cases.sentence: 这本书，小王已经看过了。

derivationStages.stageRecord: This analysis generates 这本书 independently as a topic rather than as an overt argument inside VP. The demonstrative selects the classifier phrase 本书. 小王 is a proper-name NP and 已经 an AdvP. 看 combines lexically with experiential 过 to form the verbal head; no syntactic head movement is posited for this suffix. A silent finite I and a right-peripheral C head pronounced 了 are prepared for the clause. The later object position will contain a null pronoun, not a movement trace.
derivationStages.statement: Prepare a base-generated topic with clause-final 了.

values.interpretation: the viewing experience now holds as a relevant established state

derivationStages.stageRecord: A silent object pro is generated as the complement of the complex verb. It receives the Theme role and abstract object Case under verbal government; 小王 receives the viewer role and occupies Spec-IP, with abstract subject Case licensed by silent finite I. 已经 adjoins to I′. The clause combines with final 了, interpreted as a clause-level change-of-state particle. The overt book DP remains a separate object in the workspace: it has never occupied the verb’s complement position. This GB analysis assumes Mandarin permits a discourse-recoverable null object without overt agreement.
derivationStages.statement: Build the clause with a pronominal empty object.

values.dependencyType: base-generated topic with null resumptive object

values.result: antecedent lies outside the local binding domain

values.licensing: clause-peripheral topic construction, not verbal argument licensing

derivationStages.stageRecord: The independently generated DP is placed in Spec-CP and linked referentially to object pro. This is external topic attachment, not movement from VP, so there is no trace or movement chain. The topic c-commands pro from outside its local IP binding domain; pro is locally free, as required for a pronominal empty category under Principle B. The topic is licensed by the topic construction rather than receiving a second verbal theta-role or object Case. Its reference identifies the book that 小王 has already had the experience of reading. The final particle remains outside the verbal head.

cases.sentence: 这本书，小王已经看过了。

values.formation: verbal suffixation rather than a clause-final C particle

derivationStages.stageRecord: This analysis combines independent topic generation with the suffixal interpretation of 了. The book DP is assembled from demonstrative 这 and classifier phrase 本书 but is not generated as an overt verbal argument. In the lexical verbal head, 看 first combines with experiential 过; outer aspectual 了 then combines with that head, presenting the viewing experience as actualized or completed. These are ordered lexical morphological operations, not syntactic head movements. 小王 and 已经 project NP and AdvP. The finite I and declarative C heads are silent.
derivationStages.statement: Prepare a base-generated topic with verbal aspectual 了.

derivationStages.stageRecord: The verb projects V′ with silent object pro as its complement. Pro receives the Theme role and abstract object Case under verbal government. 小王 occupies Spec-IP and receives the viewer role and abstract subject Case; 已经 adjoins to I′. Silent declarative C closes the clause. The book DP remains separate and has not occupied any position in VP. The analysis assumes discourse licensing of Mandarin object pro, rather than agreement-based identification. Since both pro and C are silent, suffixal 了 is already the final pronounced element of the clause.
derivationStages.statement: Build the suffixed predicate with an independently generated null object.

values.dependencyType: base-generated topic with null resumptive object

values.result: antecedent lies outside the local binding domain

values.licensing: clause-peripheral topic construction, not verbal argument licensing

derivationStages.stageRecord: The independent book DP is attached in Spec-CP and establishes the reference of object pro. It does not move from the object position, and no movement trace is introduced. Pro retains its verbal theta-role and Case and is free within its local IP domain; its topic antecedent lies outside that domain, satisfying Principle B. The overt DP is licensed as a topic, not as an additional argument of 看. The final 了 remains inside the complex verbal head, distinguishing this structure from the base-generated-topic analysis with clause-final C.
derivationStages.statement: Complete the base-generated topic analysis with suffixal 了.

cases.sentence: 昨天买的那本书，小李还没有看。

derivationStages.stageRecord: Merge 买 with an unpronounced nominal operator in its theme position. Merge a silent little-v head with this predicate and introduce a null agent in its specifier. Adjoin 昨天 to the resulting verbal constituent, then merge a silent temporal head. Labels identify the projecting lexical item or functional category; the binary structures are Bare Phrase Structure objects, not additional X-bar levels. The relative clause's null subject is contextually interpreted and is not yet identified with 小李.
derivationStages.statement: Construct the relative clause with an unpronounced subject and an object operator.

values.interpretation: abstraction over the theme of buying

derivationStages.stageRecord: The relative temporal head agrees with the null subject, which undergoes Internal Merge to its specifier. Merge the head-final relativizing C pronounced 的 with that completed temporal constituent. C then attracts the object operator to its left edge. Both operator occurrences and both subject occurrences remain unpronounced. The operator chain makes this a relative clause about the thing bought, rather than an independent assertion that somebody bought something yesterday.
derivationStages.statement: Complete the operator relative headed by 的.

values.interpretation: the book that a contextually supplied agent bought yesterday

derivationStages.stageRecord: Merge the classifier 本 with the noun 书 and merge the demonstrative 那 with that classifier constituent. Adjoin the completed relative clause to this demonstrative nominal. Attachment outside the demonstrative constituent is sentence-specific: the pronounced relative clause precedes 那本书, rather than following 那本. Interpret the operator abstraction as a restrictive property of the book. The three separate lexical heads jointly realize the single supplied token 那本书; the token boundary does not collapse their syntactic distinctions.
derivationStages.statement: Build the demonstrative-classifier nominal and attach its preceding relative clause.

derivationStages.stageRecord: In this analysis the initial book nominal originates as the complement of 看. Merge that object with 看, introduce a silent little-v head, and merge the proper-name subject 小李 in the external-argument position. Merge preverbal 没有 as a negative auxiliary head, adjoin 还 above its projection, and merge a silent temporal head. This gives 还 scope over the negative proposition: the relevant reading or looking-at event has still not occurred. 没有 is retained as one lexical negative head; no independent pronounced 有 or perfect suffix is posited. The proper name is one nominal terminal, jointly associated with the supplied tokens 小 and 李.
derivationStages.statement: Merge the book nominal as the matrix object and build the negative predicate.

relations.relation: subject Internal Merge and chain pronunciation

derivationStages.stageRecord: The matrix temporal head agrees with the subject already present in the external-argument position. Internal Merge places a second occurrence of that subject in the temporal specifier, above 还 and 没有. Pronounce only the higher occurrence; the lower copy retains its lexical content but is silent. Consequently, the two-token realization of the proper name is now associated only with the higher occurrence. The book nominal remains in the object position at this stage, providing the source required for subsequent topicalization.
derivationStages.statement: Raise 小李 to the matrix subject position.

values.lowerRepresentation: silent trace abbreviating the lower copy

derivationStages.stageRecord: Merge a silent topic head above the matrix temporal constituent, then internally merge the book nominal from the previously established object position into the topic specifier. The lower nominal occurrence is represented by an unpronounced trace, an abbreviation of the unpronounced copy; the higher occurrence retains the complete relative-clause and demonstrative-classifier structure. Their shared identity makes the initial nominal the syntactic theme of 看 despite its left-peripheral pronunciation. This yields the integrated reading 'That book bought yesterday, Xiaoli still has not read.' The relative clause's null agent may be Xiaoli or another contextual individual without changing this structure. The comma and final full stop indicate the written topic boundary and utterance boundary but are not additional tokens in the supplied list.
